text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Tenno Sho approaching in the spring, Rice Shower intensifies her training so she can become a blue rose for more and more people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it seems she's also worried about disappointing those who are helping her reach that goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy argues that the blue rose in the story was unable to bloom by itself, so Rice Shower should also reach out for help when she needs it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words hit hard, and Rice Shower decides that she does, in fact, need help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She asks Mihono Bourbon to assist with her training, and Bourbon agrees. Thus begins Bourbon's rumored "demonic" training regimen.
